Record Class BoardDTO

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.message.classesDTO.BoardDTO
Record Components:
upperBuildingsIds - card ids of the upper building row
lowerBuildingsIds - card ids of the lower building row
upperCharEvIds - card ids of the upper character / event row
lowerCharEvIds - card ids of the lower character / event row
offerTilesLetters - letters identifying the offer tiles, in board order
orderTileCount - number of order tiles still available on the board
eventCardIds - card ids of the cards in either row that are Event cards (a subset of upperCharEvIds / lowerCharEvIds)
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record BoardDTO(List<Integer> upperBuildingsIds, List<Integer> lowerBuildingsIds, List<Integer> upperCharEvIds, List<Integer> lowerCharEvIds, List<String> offerTilesLetters, int orderTileCount, List<Integer> eventCardIds) extends Record implements Serializable
Transport snapshot of the shared central board. The card rows are sent as lists of card ids (resolved back to full cards on the client via its local card catalog) rather than the cards themselves, keeping the payload small and decoupling the wire format from the model classes.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
